decisions.rule: Represent affected assets, stolen quantity, frozen/recovered quantity, existing token inventory, remaining shortfall, market purchases and OTC purchases as separate fields. Never convert aggregate USD reserve funding into an XRP quantity.

Do not admit Binance's $1.34B aggregate acquisition budget as XRP demand. Admit only when a token-specific XRP obligation, existing holdings, recovery offsets and executed market/OTC quantities are independently evidenced with timestamps.
Use identical wallet sets and explicit hot/cold/wrapped/non-customer classifications. Same-wallet balance changes are custody observations, not customer flows, net spot buying or tradable float.
Keep Bitquery PoR labels separate from official Binance downloadable-address-file membership. Keep Binance 14's Ethereum PoR evidence separate from the five XRPL source accounts.

The Binance event, exchange balance deltas and replenishment announcement remain context-only until synchronized, independently corroborated and walk-forward tested. Forecast status remains NOT_ISSUED.
